name: 4-T-TRIS
summary: 4-Thiotrisescaline (4-T-TRIS), also known as 4-thiotrescaline or as 4-ethylthio-3,5-diethoxyphenethylamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of trisescaline (TRIS; trescaline) in which the ethoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with an ethylthio group.
